semverGroups.label: Peer ranges stay ranges — a peer dep says what a consumer MAY bring, and pinning one would make @iace/app-kit demand the exact React this monorepo happens to be on.
Everything else is pinned exactly. A caret across seven workspaces is seven chances for two of them to resolve differently, and a lockfile that hides it until one of them breaks.

versionGroups.label: A peer range is not a version to agree on — react ^19.0.0 in a package and react 19.2.8 in an app are the same statement, said twice for two different audiences.
Internal packages are always workspace:*, never a published version.
